metadata.case_name: TING SIU KI v. WUN CHE MING AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: fireman for the Fire Services Department

injuries.description: trigger finger condition over the right middle finger PIPJ
source: the plaintiff has in fact suffered from a trigger finger condition over the right middle finger PIPJ by the time when he was examined by the doctor at the A&E at TMH.
The provisional diagnosis made by the attending doctor at the A&E was "right middle finger injury" and "right middle finger PIPJ trigger finger".
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of flexor muscle, fascia or tendon of other finger at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: sprain or strain injury to his right middle finger (flexor tendon) sustained during the accident
source: it was likely that he suffered from sprained or strain injury to his right middle finger during the accident causing a forceful flexion rendering the flexor tendon to have subsequent inflammation and swelling, thus causing the subsequent triggering.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of flexor muscle, fascia or tendon of other finger at wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: pain in his right forearm and right palm
middle finger was folded up and could not be straightened
swelling on his right hand finger
tenderness over the right middle finger PIPJ
trigger finger over right middle finger PIPJ
active range of movement limited by pain and stiffness
residual pain over the middle finger scar
reduced sensation over volar side of his middle finger
reduced right middle finger active movement but passive movement is full
very much weakened right hand grip strength (as reported in joint examination)

treatments_received: operation for the release of the right middle finger triggering performed on 31 July 2009 at Pok Oi Hospital
outpatient follow-up at Pok Oi Hospital

losses.description: Trigger finger affecting right middle finger PIPJ causing pain, triggering, tenderness, limited active movement and residual pain over the surgical scar.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Plaintiff avoids using his right hand for heavy duty at work and takes precautions when playing sports.

comparable_cases.injury_description: swelling to his right hand with no fracture or dislocation; emergency operation of fasciotomy performed; residual stiffness and numbness
